name: Ready Room
author: Greg DeYoung (fork of Austin Larson's dielerorn.gamecenter)
description: Omarchy gaming panel: a game-mode session (keep-awake, do-not-disturb, night light, performance power profile), controller and gamepad battery + rumble test, a gpu-screen-recorder instant-replay buffer with one-key clip saving, and a CPU/GPU/VRAM stats overlay that pairs with MangoHud for FPS. Replaces six bar widgets with one pre-game ritual.

barWidget.description: Session toggles, controllers and clip capture in one popout

schema.label: Opens showing
schema.description: Which tab the panel is on when it opens. Also follows whichever tab you last left it on.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: In the shell's spacing units, so it follows your scale. Wider than the screen is trimmed to fit.

schema.label: Session keeps the screen awake
schema.description: Only ever claimed when stay-awake is off to begin with. If you turned it on yourself, or another plugin holds it, Ready Room leaves it alone and says so in the panel.

schema.label: Session silences notifications
schema.description: Turns do-not-disturb on for the session and puts it back afterwards — unless you change it yourself mid-session, in which case your change wins.

schema.label: Session turns off night light
schema.description: Restores the exact colour temperature you had, rather than whatever default hyprsunset comes back with.

schema.label: Session sets the performance power profile
schema.description: Hidden on machines that have no performance profile, which is most desktops with a placeholder platform driver.

schema.label: Replay buffer length
schema.description: Seconds kept in the buffer — 1, 5, 10 or 15 minutes, Windows Game Bar style. Disk storage is the default; a 10-minute RAM buffer holds gigabytes for the whole session.

schema.label: Replay buffer held in
schema.description: RAM is instant and costs memory for the whole session. Disk trades that for writes to your drive — the sane default once buffers run minutes.

schema.label: Clip folder
schema.description: Where keybind dumps land. Empty = Videos/Clips (or $OMARCHY_SCREENRECORD_DIR).

schema.label: Replay quality
schema.description: Bitrate is scaled from this by your monitor's pixels and frame rate, so the same tier costs more on an ultrawide.

schema.label: Replay audio
schema.description: 'both' adds your microphone to the desktop audio.

schema.label: Overlay corner
schema.description: Which corner the in-game stats sit in, on whichever screen the game is on.

schema.label: Overlay shows GPU power draw
schema.description: NVIDIA only; the AMD sysfs path doesn't report it.
